## Wave 4 Summary

Wave 4 closes two robustness/determinacy questions, BOTH re-reading existing substrate-IS observables — neither introduces a new substrate prediction.

- **W4-1** (`S99-W4-A0A2-LMAX13`) extends the FULL-physical Pauli-Villars a₀/a₂ continuation to L_max ≥ 13 to test whether the within-family L_max drift `d_PV` (= 0.05703 at the S98 L_max=10→12 pair, sitting in the INFO band (0.05, 0.10]) shrinks below ε_FI = 0.05 — promoting the capstone §8.5 tier-2 survival INFO → PASS. The survival LABEL is already regulator-INVARIANT (S98 V.8: SURVIVE under both the FI-anchor a₀/a₂=0.21756 and the full-PV anchor 0.51060, byte-identical, Δ_survival_margin=0); the residual RD direction is localized to the L_max axis, NOT the PV-vs-Mellin axis. This gate tests ONLY that L_max-axis residual.
- **W4-2** (`S99-W4-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN`) enumerates substrate observables whose value depends on κ (the M_KK⁻¹→seconds knob) AND that fall in a realized detector/measurement band, to test whether ANY independent (non-consistency) κ-pin exists. S98 V.7 (`S98-KAPPA-INDEP-FROM-CGWB-FREQ` FAIL, audit 10d31d0e) already closed the CGWB-frequency axis (f_obs(κ_nat)=8.4835e+39 Hz, +28.9 dec above the optimistic HF ceiling); any future independent κ-pin must come from a DIFFERENT observable. LOW leverage (Tier-3/4 — κ's epistemic status does not gate any observational prediction); planned LAST.

**Carry-forward source**: W4-1 from `session-98-w5-workingpaper.md` §"Carry-Forward Computations" CF-S99-W5-A0A2-LMAX-PV-CONTINUATION [genuine-math]; W4-2 from `session-98-w4-workingpaper.md` §"Carry-Forward Computations" CF-S99-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN [Q-other; solo compute follow-up].

**Gate-ID equivalences (WP pre-registration → S99-wave-consistent rename)**:
- `S99-W4-A0A2-LMAX13` ≡ WP pre-reg `S99-W5-A0A2-LMAX13` (renamed W5→W4 for S99 four-wave consistency).
- `S99-W4-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN` ≡ WP pre-reg `S99-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN`.

No gate-ID collision with S98 (S98 used `S98-A0A2-TIER2-PV-INVARIANCE` and `S98-KAPPA-INDEP-FROM-CGWB-FREQ`; both S99 IDs carry the `S99-W4-` prefix).

## Wave 4 Decision Point Prerequisites

Wave 4 is INDEPENDENT of Waves 1, 2, 3 (per `session-99-context.md` §"Wave partition overview": "Waves 3 and 4 are independent of Waves 1/2"). Both W4 gates consume ONLY closed S97/S98 verdicts + on-disk caches; NO intra-session prereq.

- **W4-1** consumes the S98 V.8 npz (`s98_a0a2_tier2_pv_invariance.npz`, the within-family drift machinery), the S97 W2-1 npz (`s97_w2_1_a0a2_pv_full_mellin.npz`, the FULL-physical PV moment producer + the L_max=12 continuation), the FULL-physical PV evaluator `computations/_shared/_analytic_zeta.py`, and the L_max=14 spectrum cache `s87_spectrum_cache_L14_tau019.npz` (already on disk — see the L_max-feasibility pre-check in the W4-1 block). NO new diagonalization.
- **W4-2** consumes the S97 Ω_GW peak-height npz (`s97_omegagw_peak_height.npz`, the κ-grid) and the closed S98 V.7 verdict line (audit 10d31d0e) as the closed-axis baseline.

```yaml
# ≡ WP pre-reg S99-W5-A0A2-LMAX13 (renamed W5→W4 for S99 wave-consistency).
# Source: session-98-w5-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"
#         CF-S99-W5-A0A2-LMAX-PV-CONTINUATION [genuine-math].

# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S99-W4-A0A2-LMAX13"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist"
hypothesis: >
  Extending the FULL-physical Pauli-Villars a₀/a₂ continuation to L_max ≥ 13
  shrinks the within-family L_max drift d_PV = |ratio_PV(L≥13) − ratio_PV(L10)|
  / |ratio_PV(L10)| below ε_FI = 0.05, promoting the capstone §8.5 tier-2
  survival from INFO to PASS.

method:
  description: >
    Re-point the _analytic_zeta off-pole Mellin evaluator to the L_max=14
    spectrum cache (s87_spectrum_cache_L14_tau019.npz, already on disk —
    Casimir-bound feasibility satisfied by cache-existence, NO new irrep
    construction). Recompute the FULL-physical PV-subtracted a₀^{PV}, a₂^{PV}
    at L_max=14 with the physical PV mass set c_j={2,−1}, m_j²/M_KK²={1,2}
    (NOT the schematic Casimir-fraction set). Form ratio_PV(L14) = a₀^{PV}(L14)
    / a₂^{PV}(L14). Compute the within-family drift d_PV = |ratio_PV(L14) −
    ratio_PV(L10)| / |ratio_PV(L10)| using ratio_PV(L10)=0.510595 (S98 V.8
    canonical). Compare d_PV against ε_FI=0.05 (PASS<) and info_band=0.10
    (INFO if in (0.05, 0.10]; FAIL if ≥ info_band OR if d_PV does not shrink
    vs the L10→L12 baseline 0.05703). The survival LABEL is NOT recomputed —
    it is regulator-INVARIANT (S98 V.8 byte-identical SURVIVE under both
    anchors); this gate tests only the RD residual on the L_max axis.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s99_w4_a0a2_lmax13.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "d_PV = |ratio_PV(L>=13) - ratio_PV(L10)| / |ratio_PV(L10)|  <  eps_FI"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0.05"          # eps_FI (= a0/a2 FI-survival drift tolerance, capstone §8.5)
  direction: "<"

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false            # eps_FI is a pre-registered survival tolerance, NOT analytically derived from the spectrum; d_PV is a numerical cache-moment drift
  proof_ref: "null"      # reason: numerical-drift threshold (survival-tolerance pin, capstone §8.5 tier-2)

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false   # d_PV is a continuous float on [0, inf); no rational mesh
  mesh_density: "continuous"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "2"                    # two Mellin moments evaluated (a0 at s-pole=4, a2 at s-pole=3) per L_max
  L_max: "13"                    # L_max_plan (the pre-registered extension target)
  L_max_operational: "14"        # L_max_operational — the on-disk L14 cache covers L_max>=13; see L_max feasibility pre-check below
  scan_range: "[10, 14]"         # drift measured across the L10 (canonical) -> L14 (operational) pair
  step_size: "N/A — discrete L_max sequence {10, 14}"
  tolerance: "0.05"              # eps_FI PASS threshold; info_band=0.10 INFO ceiling
  scheme: "TIER2-SURVIVAL-DUAL-ANCHOR-FI-vs-FULL-PV"   # matches S98 V.8 scheme tag lineage
  convention: "RATIO-LABEL-DISTANCE-poleconv-A-double-PV-FULL-PHYSICAL"  # matches S98 V.8 convention; FULL physical PV (NOT schematic)
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg"       # _analytic_zeta._heat_kernel_gpu_factory runs the heat kernel on GPU; cache eigenvalues are pre-built (no diagonalization)
  # CONDITIONAL pins (declared because they apply):
  regulator_pin_a0: "a_0^{Pauli-Villars}"   # poleconv-A-double; pole_in_s=4, curvature_grade_n=0; d=8 (regulator-pin-discipline.md)
  regulator_pin_a2: "a_2^{Pauli-Villars}"   # poleconv-A-double; pole_in_s=3, curvature_grade_n=2; d=8
  poleconv: "A-double"                        # zeta(s)=Sum m_k lambda_k^{-2s}; poles at s=(d-n)/2
  CLASS: "FULL"            # full-physical PV via _analytic_zeta.py; NOT SCHEMATIC -> NO -SCHEMATIC convention suffix, NO `# tier_pin=TIER-2` row (S98 V.8 / S97 W2-1 precedent: substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(iv) FULL-side)
  # L_max feasibility pre-check (LOAD-BEARING; math-scripts.md §"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility Pre-Check"):
  #   The recursive Casimir-projection irrep-construction at p+q >= 13 may TIMEOUT within an agent slot (math-scripts.md: "irrep construction at p+q >= 13 may not complete within an agent timeslot").
  #   RESOLUTION — Casimir-bound + cache cross-check route (option 1): an L_max=14 master spectrum cache ALREADY EXISTS on disk:
  #     computations/session-87/s87_spectrum_cache_L14_tau019.npz  (sector_evals keyed by Peter-Weyl (p,q), abs_evals per sector; 1.34 MB).
  #   => L_max_operational=14 >= L_max_plan=13 is achieved by RE-POINTING _analytic_zeta to the cached L14 sector eigenvalues; NO new irrep construction fires, so the timeout risk is structurally moot.
  #   The producing script MUST set L_max_operational=14 in the npz output keys AND assert the L14 cache supplies all sectors the bottom-K Mellin moment consumes (truncation_consistent flag). If for any reason the L14 cache is unusable at runtime, FALL BACK to the Friedrich-Bär structural-saturation analytic argument (math-scripts.md option 2) and tag the verdict scheme `...-FB-SATURATION-ANALYTIC`. Honest disclosure of any operational deviation is MANDATORY in the WP §"Methodology" + the verdict convention tag.

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "analytic_zeta_module", "s87_L14_cache", "s98_v8_npz", "s97_w2_1_npz", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY ([SIGN] drift-shrink-direction claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Extending L_max from 10 to >=13 (operationally 14) SHRINKS the
            within-family PV drift d_PV toward zero (below eps_FI)."

    Step 1 (Definitions, cited):
      ratio_PV(L) := a_0^{PV}(L) / a_2^{PV}(L)                         [FULL-physical PV-subtracted Seeley-DeWitt ratio at truncation L; producer _analytic_zeta.py, PV set c={2,-1}, m^2={1,2}]
      a_0^{PV}(L) = Mellin moment at s-pole=4 (n=0), PV-subtracted     [regulator a_0^{Pauli-Villars}, poleconv-A-double, d=8]
      a_2^{PV}(L) = Mellin moment at s-pole=3 (n=2), PV-subtracted     [regulator a_2^{Pauli-Villars}, poleconv-A-double, d=8]
      ratio_PV(L10) = 0.510595                                         [S98 V.8 canonical, npz key ratio_PV_L10]
      ratio_PV(L12) = 0.481478                                         [S98 V.8 cross-check, npz key ratio_PV_L12]
      d_PV(L) := |ratio_PV(L) - ratio_PV(L10)| / |ratio_PV(L10)|       [within-family relative drift vs the L10 canonical anchor]
      eps_FI = 0.05                                                    [capstone §8.5 tier-2 FI-survival drift tolerance]

    Step 2 (Substitute the L10->L12 baseline, no simplification):
      d_PV(L12) = |0.481478 - 0.510595| / |0.510595|
               = |-0.029117| / 0.510595

    Step 3 (Simplify, one step per line):
      d_PV(L12) = 0.029117 / 0.510595
               = 0.057026
      => 0.05 < 0.057026 <= 0.10  =>  d_PV(L12) sits in the INFO band (eps_FI, info_band].

    Step 4 (Direction read-off — the [SIGN] claim under test):
      The signed step ratio_PV(L10)->ratio_PV(L12) = 0.510595->0.481478 is DECREASING (Delta = -0.029117).
      The DRIFT-SHRINK hypothesis predicts that continuing L10->L14 the SUCCESSIVE relative
      change shrinks: |ratio_PV(L14) - ratio_PV(L10)| / |ratio_PV(L10)| < |ratio_PV(L12) - ratio_PV(L10)| / |ratio_PV(L10)| = 0.057026,
      i.e. the cache-moment ratio CONVERGES (Friedrich-Bär truncation-saturation: new high-(p,q) sectors at p+q in {13,14} carry |lambda| >= eta_FB*sqrt(C_2+1), their Mellin weight at s-pole>=3 is suppressed by |lambda|^{-2s}, so their contribution to ratio_PV is bounded and DIMINISHING).
      PASS direction: d_PV(L14) < eps_FI=0.05  (drift crosses below the FI tolerance => survival INFO->PASS).
      The gate is OPEN between PASS (convergent below eps_FI), INFO (narrows but stays in (0.05,0.10]), and FAIL (does not shrink => RD is structural on the L_max axis).

    Conclusion (NOT pre-judged): the directional pre-registration is "d_PV shrinks with L_max"; the
    gate's [SIGN] sign_verdict = PASS iff sign(ratio_PV(L14)-ratio_PV(L10)) tracks the predicted
    convergent-decrease AND d_PV(L14) < d_PV(L12); magnitude_verdict keys d_PV(L14) vs eps_FI/info_band.

# (8) input_files — every file producing_script reads, with SHA pin
input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  analytic_zeta_module:
    path: "computations/_shared/_analytic_zeta.py"

    sha256: "fa2bfb83c74ff151b138c83498f54ca2c87a61fc59ec1ae5189bb6aab360480c"   # L_max=14 sector_evals — the L_max>=13 feasibility resolver
  s98_v8_npz:
    path: "computations/session-98/s98_a0a2_tier2_pv_invariance.npz"
    sha256: "77f8ea525b02d2710677eaa2afa0fc5eac6049c4d03b9a871a825488470a4e3b"   # CONTENT sha (NOT the verdict audit_sha256 4522ea7e); carries ratio_PV_L10/L12, d_PV, eps_FI, info_band machinery
  s97_w2_1_npz:
    path: "computations/session-97/s97_w2_1_a0a2_pv_full_mellin.npz"
    sha256: "20a398bd2b7386970a036b551d29d9fa449423edaff4ad071cb329796c910d3a"   # FULL-physical PV moment producer + L_max=12 continuation baseline

# ---- Conditional blocks ----
# fb_pair — this gate lands on the §8.5 tier-2 survival manifold (prior-cite history: S97 W2-1, S98 V.8).
fb_pair:
  forward: "S97-W2-1-A0A2-PV-FULL-MELLIN (object-definedness, supplies FULL-PV moments + L12 continuation); S98-A0A2-TIER2-PV-INVARIANCE (within-family drift machinery + survival label)"

# dual_prior — two interpretive tracks on the d_PV outcome.
dual_prior:
  track_A: "Track A (convergent / RD-vanishing): d_PV shrinks below eps_FI with L_max => the L_max-axis residual is a truncation artifact that vanishes in the continuum => §8.5 survival INFO->PASS. Prior 0.5."
  track_B: "Track B (structural RD on L_max): d_PV does not shrink => the RD direction is a genuine structural feature on the L_max axis (NOT a truncation artifact) => survival stays INFO, the RD is reported as a structural L_max-axis property. Prior 0.5."
  discriminator: "PASS (d_PV(L14)<0.05) -> 0.9 to Track A; FAIL (no shrink) -> 0.9 to Track B; INFO (0.05<d_PV(L14)<=0.10) -> unchanged (the extension narrows but does not decide)."

# ---- Output artifacts ----
output_artifacts:

    must_contain:

      - "\\*\\*Verdict\\*\\*:.*(PASS|FAIL|INFO)"
      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"
      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  d_PV(L_max>=13) < eps_FI=0.05. The within-family PV drift crosses below the
  FI-survival tolerance: the RD residual on the L_max axis is a vanishing
  truncation artifact, and the capstone §8.5 tier-2 a₀/a₂ survival is promoted
  INFO -> PASS. The surviving-side partition is robust to L_max at the
  FI tolerance.
FAIL_meaning: >
  d_PV(L_max>=13) does NOT shrink (>= info_band=0.10 OR >= d_PV(L12)=0.05703).
  The RD direction is STRUCTURAL on the L_max axis — a genuine feature of the
  truncation, not an artifact that vanishes in the continuum. The survival
  LABEL is untouched (it is regulator-INVARIANT, S98 V.8), but the §8.5 tier-2
  survival stays INFO and the RD is recorded as a structural L_max-axis
  property. This FAIL does NOT retract any substrate-IS structural fact.
INFO_meaning: >
  d_PV(L_max>=13) in (0.05, 0.10] — narrows toward eps_FI but does not cross
  it. The extension reduces the drift without deciding the survival promotion;
  §8.5 tier-2 survival remains INFO with the tightened drift recorded.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-99/s99_w4_a0a2_lmax13.py"
    - "computations/session-99/s99_w4_a0a2_lmax13.npz"
    - "computations/session-99/s99_w4_a0a2_lmax13.png"
  estimated_time: "~0.5 wave (NO new diagonalization — L14 cache on disk; re-point _analytic_zeta + recompute two Mellin moments + drift)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The arrow flows D_K eigenvalues -> a₀/a₂ Seeley-DeWitt spectral
  moments -> the §8.5 tier-2 survival partition. The a₀ (zeroth, cosmological-
  term weight-0) and a₂ (second, Einstein-Hilbert weight-2) moments are
  spectral functionals of the L_max-truncated Jensen-deformed SU(3) D_K
  spectrum at tau_fold=0.190. The substrate IS the truncated spectral triple
  (A_K^{<=L}, H_K^{<=L}, D_K^{<=L}); the a₀/a₂ ratio is a substrate-IS read-off,
  not a laboratory measurement. The gate asks whether extending the truncation
  L_max to 13/14 leaves the surviving-side partition signed-distance invariant
  to within the FI tolerance — a robustness check on the spectral-moment
  partition, NOT a new prediction. The survival LABEL is already a regulator-
  INVARIANT substrate-IS fact (S98 V.8: SURVIVE under both FI and full-PV
  anchors); this gate probes only the L_max-axis RD residual on the
  ratio-magnitude, which is a methodology-floor refinement of an already-
  established substrate-IS survival.

## §W4-2. S99-W4-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN

```yaml
# ≡ WP pre-reg S99-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN.
# Source: session-98-w4-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"
#         CF-S99-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN [Q-other; solo compute follow-up].
# LOW leverage (Tier-3/4 — kappa's epistemic status does NOT gate any
# observational prediction); planned LAST.

# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S99-W4-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "NON-PHONONIC"
agent_type: "mack-cosmic-bridge"
hypothesis: >
  At least one substrate observable whose value depends on κ (the M_KK⁻¹->s
  knob) AND falls in a realized detector/measurement band exists, which would
  upgrade κ from CONSISTENCY-PINNED to INDEPENDENTLY-PINNED.

method:
  description: >
    Enumerate the κ-dependent substrate-IS observable set whose seconds-scale
    image is a function of κ (κ converts dimensionless substrate quantities to
    laboratory seconds/Hz). The CGWB-peak-FREQUENCY axis (f_obs ∝ κ) is
    ALREADY CLOSED by S98 V.7 (FAIL, audit 10d31d0e; f_obs(κ_nat)=8.4835e+39 Hz,
    +28.9 dec above the optimistic HF ceiling) — so this scan targets the
    COMPLEMENT observable set (κ-dependent seconds-scale predictions OTHER than
    the CGWB peak frequency). For each enumerated observable O_i(κ), evaluate
    O_i across the κ-grid (s97_omegagw_peak_height.npz key kappa_grid, 121 pts
    κ∈[1e-20,1e-10]) and test realized-detector-band membership against the
    union of detector/measurement horizons (the same horizon union S98 V.7
    used: {PTA, LISA, LIGO/ET, resonant-HF<=1e11 Hz}, plus any non-GW realized
    measurement band the enumerated observable maps into). NOTE (flat-grid
    discipline): Ω_peak is κ-INDEPENDENT on this grid (Omega_peak_grid is flat
    at 9.15e-5 across all 121 κ) — the κ-VARYING image is the frequency/seconds
    axis, so the scan MUST enumerate frequency/time-scale-type observables
    (e.g. characteristic transit timescale, acoustic-emission period, relic
    coherence time), NOT the κ-flat amplitude. The κ-natural value is
    κ_nat = ℏ/M_KK = 8.860439881925477e-42 s (canonical M_KK_inv_seconds).
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s99_w4_kappa_alt_observable_scan.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: "EXISTS O_i in {kappa-dependent substrate observables, complement of CGWB-peak-freq} such that O_i(kappa) in (union of realized detector/measurement bands)"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "count(O_i(kappa) in-band) >= 1"   # set-membership PASS; non-numerical gate
  direction: ">="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false            # set-membership / determinacy gate — no analytic threshold (substrate observables either map into a realized band or they do not)
  proof_ref: "null"      # reason: set-membership determinacy gate (NON-PHONONIC gate-object)

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false   # band-membership is a boolean over an enumerated observable set, not a rational mesh
  mesh_density: "N/A — set-membership over enumerated observables; kappa swept on a 121-pt log grid"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "121"                  # kappa-grid cardinality (s97_omegagw_peak_height.npz key kappa_grid)
  L_max: "N/A — kappa-determinacy gate consumes scalar seconds-scale predictions, not a spectral truncation"
  scan_range: "[1e-20, 1e-10]"   # kappa-grid bounds (log-spaced, 121 pts) — the candidate independent-pin window
  step_size: "log-spaced (121 pts over 10 decades)"
  tolerance: "band-membership boolean (in-band if O_i(kappa) within a realized detector/measurement horizon)"
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "ABSOLUTE"         # matches S98 V.7 convention lineage
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8"       # scalar seconds-scale evaluations over a 121-pt grid — CPU, OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 before numpy import
  # CONDITIONAL pins: none — no Seeley-DeWitt a_n cited (no regulator_pin), no SCHEMATIC helper (no CLASS pin), value NOT cited downstream as a canonical (no publication_precision; the gate's deliverable is a determinacy verdict, not a published number)

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY ([SIGN] in-band-vs-out-of-band direction)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "An enumerated kappa-dependent observable O_i(kappa) lands INSIDE a
            realized detector/measurement band (=> kappa INDEPENDENTLY-PINNED),
            vs OUTSIDE all bands (=> kappa stays CONSISTENCY-PINNED)."

    Step 1 (Definitions, cited):
      kappa := M_KK^{-1} -> seconds conversion knob; kappa_nat = hbar/M_KK = 8.860439881925477e-42 s   [canonical M_KK_inv_seconds]
      O_i(kappa) := seconds/Hz image of a dimensionless substrate-IS observable under kappa             [substrate-IS quantity * kappa^p for the observable's dimension power p]
      f_obs(kappa_nat) = 8.4835e+39 Hz                                                                   [S98 V.7 CGWB-peak-freq; npz key f_peak_Hz]
      detector_band_union = {PTA, LISA, LIGO/ET, resonant-HF<=1e11 Hz} (+ any realized non-GW band)      [S98 V.7 horizon union]
      Omega_peak_grid = 9.15e-5 (FLAT across all 121 kappa)                                              [s97 npz; kappa-INDEPENDENT amplitude — NOT a candidate]

    Step 2 (Substitute the closed-axis baseline, no simplification):
      For the CGWB-peak FREQUENCY observable (the ONE axis V.7 tested):
        f_obs(kappa_nat) = 8.4835e+39 Hz
        highest detector-band edge = resonant-HF ceiling = 1e+11 Hz
        gap = log10(f_obs) - log10(1e+11) = 39.9286 - 11 = +28.929 decades ABOVE

    Step 3 (Simplify — the closed axis is OUT-of-band by +28.9 dec):
      f_obs(kappa_nat) > highest band edge  by +28.929 dec  => member_of_any_band = False   [S98 V.7 FAIL, audit 10d31d0e]
      => the CGWB-FREQUENCY axis supplies NO independent seconds-scale; it is EXCLUDED from this scan (already closed).

    Step 4 (Direction read-off — the [SIGN] claim under test, on the COMPLEMENT set):
      The gate tests the COMPLEMENT observable set {O_i != f_obs_CGWB_peak}. For each O_i:
        IN-BAND  direction (PASS): O_i(kappa) within [band_lo, band_hi] for some realized detector/measurement band
                 => that observable supplies an independent seconds-scale anchor => kappa INDEPENDENTLY-PINNED.
        OUT-OF-BAND direction (FAIL/INFO): every O_i(kappa) lies strictly outside all realized bands
                 => no independent anchor => kappa stays CONSISTENCY-PINNED (the determinacy question stays open).
      sign_verdict = PASS iff the computed in/out-of-band direction matches the enumeration's prediction
      for the observable that decides the gate (>=1 in-band => PASS-direction; 0 in-band => FAIL-direction).

    Conclusion (NOT pre-judged): given the substrate's seconds-scale predictions sit far from realized GW
    bands at kappa_nat (the CGWB-freq axis is +28.9 dec out), the OPEN possibilities are: PASS (some
    complement observable unexpectedly lands in-band -> independent pin) vs FAIL/INFO (none does ->
    consistency-pinned). The gate is genuinely open between the two.

dual_prior:

Prior 0.15 (the CGWB-freq axis is +28.9 dec out; the substrate seconds-scale predictions are far from realized GW bands, so an in-band complement observable is a priori unlikely)."
  track_B: "Track B (no independent pin): every complement observable is out-of-band => kappa stays CONSISTENCY-PINNED, determinacy stays open. Prior 0.85."
  discriminator: "PASS (>=1 in-band) -> 0.9 to Track A; FAIL/INFO (0 in-band) -> 0.9 to Track B."

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  At least one κ-dependent complement observable O_i(κ) lands in a realized
  detector/measurement band. κ is upgraded CONSISTENCY-PINNED ->
  INDEPENDENTLY-PINNED: an independent (non-consistency) anchor for the
  M_KK⁻¹->seconds knob exists, and the determinacy question CLOSES. (LOW
  leverage — this does not gate any observational prediction, but it settles
  κ's epistemic status.)
FAIL_meaning: >
  Every enumerated κ-dependent complement observable is out-of-band. κ stays
  CONSISTENCY-PINNED: no independent seconds-scale anchor exists across the
  enumerated set, and the determinacy question stays OPEN. Combined with the
  S98 V.7 closure of the CGWB-frequency axis, this maps the κ-determinacy
  corridor as closed across BOTH the frequency axis and the complement set.
INFO_meaning: >
  An enumerated observable lands near a band edge (marginal membership) OR the
  enumeration narrows the open corridor without a clean in-band landing. κ stays
  CONSISTENCY-PINNED with the marginal case documented; the determinacy
  question remains open pending a cleaner observable.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-99/s99_w4_kappa_alt_observable_scan.py"
    - "computations/session-99/s99_w4_kappa_alt_observable_scan.npz"
    - "computations/session-99/s99_w4_kappa_alt_observable_scan.png"
  estimated_time: "~1 wave (enumerate the kappa-dependent complement observable set + scalar seconds-scale evaluation across the 121-pt kappa-grid + band-membership test)"

substrate_framing: |
  NON-PHONONIC gate-OBJECT (the determinacy / epistemic status of κ, an
  emergent transport knob), but the underlying κ-dependent observables are
  substrate-IS. κ = M_KK⁻¹ is the conversion that maps dimensionless substrate-
  IS quantities (transit timescales, acoustic-emission periods, relic coherence
  times — all read off the D_K spectrum at tau_fold) into laboratory seconds/Hz.
  The arrow flows D_K eigenvalues -> dimensionless substrate-IS observable ->
  (× κ^p) -> laboratory seconds-scale image -> detector-band membership test.
  The gate-OBJECT (does an independent κ-pin exist?) is a methodology/
  determinacy question, NON-PHONONIC; it does NOT invert the substrate-first
  direction — κ is the emergent transport leg, not a substrate primitive. The
  scan does NOT introduce a new substrate prediction; it re-reads existing
  substrate-IS seconds-scale predictions against realized measurement bands to
  test whether any of them independently pins the transport knob. The CGWB-peak-
  frequency axis is excluded (already closed by S98 V.7); this gate tests the
  complement set.

## Wave 4 → Wave 5 Decision Point

There is NO Wave 5 in Session 99 (the session is 4 waves / 7 gates per `session-99-context.md` §"Wave partition overview"). Wave 4 is TERMINAL.

**Downstream routing for each W4 verdict** (7-field decision-point format per `output-standards.md`):

**W4-1 (`S99-W4-A0A2-LMAX13`)**:
- **PASS** (d_PV(L14) < 0.05): route a capstone §8.5 tier-2 survival status-cell update INFO -> PASS to `session-99-housekeeping.md` §A (designated-writer prose fix per the capstone-hygiene gate Q3 — a PROVEN/CONDITIONAL/BROKEN/INFO status change). The §8.5 prose tag reconciles against Atlas D04. The capstone-hygiene 5-question gate fires Q3-YES (status change) ⇒ run the gate before session-close.
- **INFO** (0.05 < d_PV(L14) <= 0.10): record the tightened drift in the §8.5 tier-2 survival cell; status stays INFO. No capstone prose down/up-tag; ledger-row drift-update only (capstone-hygiene Q3-NO on a non-status-changing tightening).
- **FAIL** (no shrink): record the RD as a structural L_max-axis property (Two-Layer reading per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Resolution-Specificity Scoping"`: Layer-1 pole-universal survival LABEL untouched; Layer-2 L_max-axis RD residual is the structural finding). NO retraction of the regulator-invariant survival fact. Carry-forward to a future session ONLY if a higher-L_max cache (L>=16) becomes a genuine compute item; otherwise the FAIL closes the L_max-axis-robustness corridor and is not re-queued (per `feedback_fix-in-session-never-defer.md` — a FAIL that maps a corridor is not a carry-forward).

**W4-2 (`S99-W4-KAPPA-ALT-OBSERVABLE-SCAN`)**:
- **PASS** (>=1 in-band): κ epistemic-status cell -> INDEPENDENTLY-PINNED; the in-band observable becomes a NEW falsifier-inventory candidate row — route to `mack-cosmic-bridge` (sole writer of `falsifier-master-inventory.md` per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md`). LOW leverage, but a status upgrade.
- **FAIL/INFO** (0 in-band / marginal): κ stays CONSISTENCY-PINNED; the determinacy corridor is mapped as closed across the frequency axis (V.7) AND the complement set (this gate). NO carry-forward (the corridor is mapped; per `feedback_fix-in-session-never-defer.md` a corridor-mapping FAIL is not future work). The determinacy question stays open BY DESIGN (κ's epistemic status does not gate any observational prediction — STRUCTURALLY-OPEN-BY-DESIGN, not a defect).

**Capstone-hygiene gate (standing 5-question discipline, `capstone-hygiene-gate.md`)**: W4-1 PASS is the only W4 outcome that touches a capstone status-bearing claim (§8.5 tier-2 survival). On W4-1 PASS, the session-close MUST run the 5-question gate (Q3-YES: PROVEN/CONDITIONAL/BROKEN/INFO status change) and route the §8.5 prose reconciliation to `session-99-housekeeping.md` §A. On W4-1 INFO/FAIL and on any W4-2 outcome, no capstone status-bearing claim changes (Q1-Q5 all NO) — the gate fires no routing action.
